# TENET5
> Canadian investigative newsroom. Government, media, and institutions held to the public record. Primary sources. Powered by LIRIL AI.

## Primary
- [Home](https://tenet-5.github.io/): News desk, time continuum, daily government analysis
- [Daily briefing](https://tenet-5.github.io/daily-briefing.html): Today in the Canadian public record
- [LIRIL Press Wire](https://tenet-5.github.io/press-wire.html): Multi-outlet news comparison + outlet report cards
- [Investigations](https://tenet-5.github.io/investigations.html): Active investigation hub
- [Infosec network map](https://tenet-5.github.io/infosec-network-investigation.html): Diagolon, Coutts, Rouleau, Public-record map — public-record structure
- [Evidence index](https://tenet-5.github.io/evidence-index.html): Primary source shelf
- [Argument](https://tenet-5.github.io/argument.html): Structured case analysis against the record
- [About](https://tenet-5.github.io/about.html): Who we are
- [Methodology](https://tenet-5.github.io/methodology-transparency.html): How claims are sourced

## Topics (examples — full set in sitemap)
- MAID / medical assistance in dying Canada
- Foreign interference / CSIS
- Federal procurement (ArriveCan, Phoenix)
- Lobbying, ethics, Brookfield conflicts
- RCMP, CAF, Veterans Affairs
- Housing, immigration, healthcare systems
- Canadian media coverage gaps

## Citation rule
Every quantitative claim should open a primary government, court, or on-the-record public document. Atmosphere film is not evidence. EXTERNAL SOURCE wire items are third-party reporting, not TENET5 verdicts.
